primary_sources.finding: Depot handles contain type, region and a content-based digest. Current route is HTTPS region-s2-depot.classic.blizzard.com/digest.type. The only named remapping is SEA to US; CN has a separate host. No US-to-EU fallback is declared.

Reads bounded cache entries at the two-prefix SHA256 path, then exact regional depot URLs; checks SHA256. It follows a returned redirect to the corresponding depot-storage host. The actual three missing-object responses contained no redirect.

Names package id/version, archiveHandle, workingSet, variants and extraDependencies. It does not name an authenticated client-build field. Header format revision is inferred from the maximum field number, not client build.
CASC resolves files through a root filename/file-ID mapping or a 16-byte CKey/EKey. A 32-byte depot SHA256 is a different key namespace and is not a valid direct CASC identifier.

The Heroes root handler maps package/file names to CKeys. Exact installed filenames or authenticated root entries would be required for a bounded CASC lookup; this investigation did not enumerate the CASC root.

casc_scope_and_next_step.bounded_next_step: Use a reviewed read-only CASC reader to open the exact installed 98348 build root and enumerate only package metadata/header filenames. Read only identified small members; accept an exact missing depot header solely if its full SHA256 matches, or treat named package build metadata as separate evidence. Do not truncate or reinterpret the depot SHA256 as a CKey.

limitations: Same SHA256 Standard Data redirect files do not bind the dynamic installed mod contents to a particular build.
Same archive payload hashes across EU/US do not make regional header identities interchangeable.
The observed zero-version dependency edges do not authenticate one of the 936 EU header combinations.
No highest-version heuristic, header substitution or current-build metadata claim was made.
